key_themes: Rising Treasury yields: 10-year hits 4.6%, highest in a year, stoking inflation fears

Ad-tech consolidation: Publicis acquires LiveRamp in $2.5B all-cash deal
AI semiconductor momentum: Nvidia pre-earnings analyst upgrades, Micron target hikes
Crypto selloff: Bitcoin falls below $77K, pressuring Coinbase and Robinhood

Rose ~14% after NextEra Energy announced $66.8B all-stock-and-cash acquisition — largest utility deal in US history, fueled by AI data center power demand
Shares fell on dilution concerns as acquirer in $66.8B Dominion deal; combined entity would be world's largest regulated utility trading under NEE ticker
Dropped ~11.4% after Phase 3 trial for metastatic melanoma failed to achieve statistical significance; Evercore ISI cut price target to $825 from $875
Fell ~8% after Jefferies initiated coverage at Underperform with $8 price target, implying 24% downside, citing structural threats and heavy Volkswagen Group customer concentration
Dropped ~9% after DA Davidson downgraded to Neutral from Buy; stock had surged recently on 684% revenue growth and $20-25B capex guidance for AI infrastructure
Gained ~4.7% on wave of AI memory analyst upgrades: Deutsche Bank raised target to $1,000, CFRA lifted to $900; HBM capacity sold out through 2026 on AI demand
Multiple analyst upgrades ahead of Wednesday earnings: KeyBanc raised target to $300, Morgan Stanley to $285, DA Davidson to $300; Blackwell GPU demand and Rubin roadmap cited
Fell ~4.4% as Bitcoin slid below $77,000, down nearly 5% on the week; $1B+ in digital asset investment product outflows in prior week reversed recent regulatory-optimism rally
Declined alongside Coinbase as Bitcoin fell below $77K; retail crypto trading platform sensitive to crypto price swings that dampen trading activity and revenue
Rose ~7% after doubling its 2026 share repurchase target to approximately $2B, signaling management confidence; buyback expansion seen as shareholder-friendly capital return

Rose modestly after record Q1 2026 results: $871M net income (+41% YoY), first-ever $5B+ revenue quarter, Mexico reached break-even ahead of plan; stock had initially dropped on elevated credit provisions
